sections.Profile:
Circus, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in April 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a circus theme. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, two spinning targets, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Circus, Clowns, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
